create_action_env: create an argparse env action that reads PET_{dest} env var before defaulting to a given value
create_action_check_env: create an argparse check_env action that checks PET_{dest} env var for boolean flag arguments
build_argparse_standalone_flag: build an argparse standalone flag using check_env action with PET_STANDALONE env var support
build_argparse_required_option: build an argparse required option using env action with PET_{dest} env var fallback
test_env_action_default: test the env action defaulting behavior when PET_{dest} is set and command-line arg is omitted
